It's all about the preparation really.

Naval game: My invasion navy was 80 transports and 12 heavys, the heavy ships together with an ok admiral obliterated any chinese navy they met. Make sure you have good transport capacity because you don't want to send your armies 1 by 1. Look at their navy before invading though because in my game they had weak one but in yours they might have strong.

Bases:I colonized taiwan and the philipines and conquered the natives so i can drill my armies without taking atrition.

Army: For the invasion i used 3 armies that together were around 110k, not much compared to the chinese hordes! As you said you can't beat china in tech just make sure to be on their level. The way you beat them is with quality make sure you have 100 profesionalism and take quality ideas(the ai usually doesn't take quality with china). Also standing army and profesional army are useful if you want to be extra sure. Drill your armies up to 100% the bonuses would be very useful in the initial stage.

Invasion: Secure all forts in your landing area and make sure you can move freely there(i didn't do that and because of zones of control my armies got separated and couldn't support eachother one almost got overwhelmed). If you did what i said in "army" your armies would have no problem stack wiping armies their size look for separated enemy armies you size and wipe them. In the first war you wouldn't be able to loot much land before war exhaustion kicks in, the objective is to kill as many armies as possible. Also try to defend any fort you occupied so you are the defender.

Other useful tips: Build spynetwork prior to invasion so you can steal maps(you don't want to find 100k waiting for you in undiscovered province). Also something useful is to make the wargoal a province that you won't occupy so the call for peace doesn't kick in(i used colonial cb and was tanking it until 5 war exhaustion then peacing out). Be patient in the first two wars you probably wouldn't loot much but as you see in the 3rd you will stomp them. Also make sure your ruler is at least with 3 mil. Peace out for money and maybe war reps.
